parameters.name: GatewayRoute
parameters.description: The information about the gateway route.

parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the route. A smaller integer indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the ASM instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the gateway route. Valid values:

- `0`: online.

- `1`: offline.

- `2`: creation or update error.
